en: Cittasaṁsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaduka (The Dyad on Mental Conjoined and Produced)
Dependent on a state that is not conjoined with and not originated by mind, there arises a state that is not conjoined with and not originated by mind, by way of root condition. … (Abbreviated.
Nine [conditions] in the case of root; … pe … nine in the case of non-disappearance.
